## What happened?

Describe the observed behavior and what you expected.

## Reproduction

## Environment

## Evidence

Include the error message or a short sanitized log. Do not attach credentials, private datasets, or model weights. For a security issue, use [private reporting](https://github.com/Bhanunamikaze/Abliteration-Workbench/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
